name: Queulat: Ventisquero Colgante
why: Across a swinging bridge and up through dripping rainforest to a lookout where a glacier hangs over a cliff and pours a waterfall into a lake.
book: Park ticket in advance at pasesparques.cl (choose the Ventisquero Colgante sector). The sector is a 2 km spur off the Carretera Austral, 20 km south of Puyuhuapi.
water: Streams along the trail; carry 1 litre.
dangers: Mud, roots and wet rock: it rains most days.
Streams can rise fast after heavy rain.
Icefall and waves from the glacier: stay at the lookout.
turnaround: Start up from the bridge before 13:30.

points.name: Río Ventisquero suspension bridge
points.note: A swinging footbridge over the grey glacier river, 100 m from the CONAF hut at the car park; the short path to Laguna Témpanos turns right after it.

points.name: Mirador Ventisquero Colgante
points.note: The lookout facing the hanging glacier and its waterfall over Laguna Témpanos. Return the same way.
